correctness.rationale: PASS: Distinct adjacent-power gaps identify the first two ones in every multi-one factor, giving exact c_k. Strictly increasing gaps make reversal of any three-one factor absent. Exactly-two-one words have reversal mates iff both left and right zero padding are at most the previous gap minus one, yielding exact B_k and #pairs floor(B_k/2). Geometric-interval summation proves the displayed formula including b=2,n=4 palindrome edge. Uniform scaling and derivative analysis gives both extrema. A separate Python enumerator checks every n up to 140 for bases 2..7; finite checks are corroboration only.
